title: SSTIM preset
description:
A sensory stimulation preset: what to deliver, in which modalities, aimed at which frequency ambits, under which safety cautions. Audit finding KR-07 and improvement plan 1.3.

This is SSTIM's own contract, not any application's. It takes inspiration from the BioSynCare catalog format documented in docs/technical/PRESET_FORMAT.md — that format solved real delivery problems and its parameter ranges are carried over — but it deliberately does not reproduce it. Three differences are the point of the redesign: a preset is composed of modality-declaring COMPONENTS rather than audio `voices`, so a visual or haptic component needs no new structure; parameters are named with their units rather than abbreviated; and the product/catalog envelope of any one application (listing status, tiering, marketing copy, per-application evidence enums) is absent, because a standard does not ratify one vendor's product taxonomy. An application may carry its own fields alongside; this schema neither requires nor validates them.

Arithmetic cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express — binaural beat frequency, symmetry pulse rate, breath-reference agreement — are enforced by scripts/preset-contract.py, which also proves these bounds agree with SHACL and with the documented ranges. Neither layer is complete alone.

model.description: Model tag. A document carrying newer fields must never claim an older tag.

id.description: Stable slug, unique within its implementation. Becomes the local part of the preset IRI.

version.description: Semantic version of this preset, independent of any catalog version.

group.description: Optional BSC framework grouping (sstim:inGroup). Optional because grouping is a framework's editorial scheme, not a property every standard-conformant preset must have.

targetBands.description: The frequency ambits this preset aims at, primary first. A band is a Hz interval, not a neural rhythm (ADR 0049).

publicClaimLevel.description: The strongest level of public statement this preset is presented with. C3 and above additionally require an authorizing evidence assessment satisfying the applicability contract (ADR 0050); this field alone authorizes nothing.

breathReference.description: The id of the single component whose oscillation guides breathing, if any. Replaces the catalog's paired hasBreathGuide flag and per-voice isOn booleans: one optional pointer cannot contradict itself, where two coupled fields can and did.

components.description: At least one stimulation component; each declares its own modality, so a preset is not implicitly audio. Deliberately un-capped: the six-layer ceiling belongs to the BSC catalog profile, where it is a real engine limit (sstim:composedOf, "1-6 voice specifications"), and carrying it into a modality-neutral contract would have been exactly the transcription this schema exists to avoid. A preset combining audio, visual and haptic layers has no principled reason to stop at six.

frequencyBand.description: Lowercase SKOS concept local names from sstim-v:FrequencyBandScheme. "gamma" and "gamma-40" are distinct concepts.

modality.description: From sstim-v:SensoryModalityScheme, and exactly the concepts it declares — scripts/preset-contract.py fails if this list invents a value. The scheme is known to be incomplete (proprioception, chemoreception and thermoception are among the senses it does not yet name, and sstim-ex:StimulusChannel already recognises gustatory and electromagnetic paths the modality scheme does not); widening it is an ontology decision, not a schema one, so this list follows the vocabulary rather than leading it.

component.description: One stimulation layer. `kind` selects which parameter set is required; `modality` says through which sense it is delivered. The two are independent on purpose: a breathing oscillation rendered as a moving light is the same kind in a different modality.

kind.description: Named for what the component is, not for the engine that renders it.

level.description: Relative intensity in [0, 1). Above 0.30 requires a rationale, which scripts/preset-contract.py enforces via the notes field. Omitted means the implementation's default for this kind.

notes.description: Free-text rationale. Required when level exceeds 0.30.

then.description: A binaural beat is produced by dichotic presentation and has no meaning outside hearing.

symmetryParameters.description: A sequence of events evenly spaced in time and, when octaveSpan is non-zero, in pitch. octaveSpan 0 collapses it to an isochronic pulse train, which is the same object with one parameter at zero rather than a separate kind.

permutation.description: Named rather than the catalog's integer code. The ordinal encoding 0-4 survives only where RDF needs a number (sstim:permutationFunction), in the order listed here.
